trace.label: ARTIFACT
trace.title: Make the new model tangible enough to react to.
trace.body: Artifacts sit flat on the page at useful scale. They are not trapped in device mockups. Provenance and annotations wait until the reader asks for them.

trace.label: RESPONSE

trace.body: When defensible metrics do not exist, a sourced response and the artifact itself can establish credibility without manufacturing certainty.

trace.label: BOUNDARY
trace.title: End with what the evidence does not prove.
trace.body: The case closes with a calm attribution boundary. This increases trust and gives the next decision somewhere honest to begin.
